minimalsanitized.rationale: ROOT_CAUSE - mint() protected only by single minter key. No supply cap, no multi-sig, no timelock. Compromised minter key allows unlimited token minting ($290M exploited).
Internal _mint implementation. Not externally reachable - the vulnerability is exposed through CA1. Supply cap absence is consequence, not independent cause.
Role rotation function. Post-compromise persistence path - not required for exploitation. Compromised key already satisfies onlyMinter.
Correctly implemented modifier. The weakness is the architectural choice (single-key minting authority) captured in CA1, not the modifier itself.
Constructor initializing minter and initial supply.
